title: The Hypno Café (Naked Audio)
description: Hidden behind a long spiral staircase, and tucked away from the narrow winding stone facades below... The Hypno Café is itself almost as private, and secluded as its varied clientele. Serving only the most trusted of guests, with personal reservations, made online, and far in advance. For those who can pass up through its spiralling entry-way, an uniquely enticing experience beckons as they open the door. Where the mystery is half the fun... InstructionsThis file involves a bit of activity on your part: • You should be seated across from a table, in a chair or couch, with a clear space on the floor around you. • Make sure you are in a private space and will not be disturbed. • You will also need to set the table before you begin with a plate and glass of water. • You may choose to place a single ripe strawberry on the plate. It will be eaten when listening. (Be safe. Do not use a real fruit if you are allergic or have other concerns.)
author: Mistress Shibby
